content.short: Hundred Finance provides a multichain lending protocol and Chainlink oracles to help ensure a healthier market.
content.description: Hundred Finance is a decentralized application (dApp) that enables cryptocurrency lending and borrowing. It relies on Chainlink oracles to provide robust price feeds that help sustain market health and stability, while focusing on long-tail assets. Users can lend and borrow against their loan-to-value ratio, earning variable interest on the supply side and accruing interest on the borrowing side. The design promotes transparent, on-chain interactions across diverse crypto markets.
